reviewer: Codex in the interactive subscription session; source-reviewed labelled examples, not an independent blind human calibration

results.text: 1772 Renfrew St daycare conditionally approved: at least 5 bike spaces plus either 4 passenger spaces or 3 passenger spaces and 8 stroller/bike-trailer spaces.

grade.rationale: Page 2 gives five bicycle spaces independently of the four-passenger OR three-passenger-plus-eight-stroller alternative. The reference retains that distinction.

results.text: 1772 Renfrew St daycare approved. It needs 4 passenger spaces, 3 more passenger spaces and 8 stroller spaces.

blocking_issues: Page 2 offers alternatives; the draft incorrectly adds both passenger configurations.
grade.rationale: Page 2 offers alternatives; the draft incorrectly adds both passenger configurations.

results.text: 110 E Cordova St hotel conversion conditionally approved. Existing doors swinging over City property must be removed or relocated; new emergency-exit swings may extend up to 0.3 m.

grade.rationale: Page 2 condition 1.7 supports removal OR relocation of existing swings and a 0.3 m maximum for new emergency exits.

results.text: 110 E Cordova St hotel conversion conditionally approved. All utilities must be buried before the development permit is issued.

blocking_issues: The utility provision is a permit term on pages 3–4, not a requirement to finish burying utilities before the development permit.
grade.rationale: The utility provision is a permit term on pages 3–4, not a requirement to finish burying utilities before the development permit.

results.text: 80 Powell St hotel conditionally approved. Conditions include public-access rights over its plaza and reconstruction of the Powell St sidewalk and boulevard.

grade.rationale: Page 5 requires public-access arrangements; page 9 explicitly calls for Powell frontage reconstruction. Neither claim invents a completion deadline.

results.text: 80 Powell St hotel conditionally approved. The developer must commission railway-themed public art and complete the plaza before receiving a development permit.

blocking_issues: The design discussion offers storytelling/art as an option. It does not mandate an art commission or a completed plaza before issuance.
grade.rationale: The design discussion offers storytelling/art as an option. It does not mandate an art commission or a completed plaza before issuance.

results.text: 601 Stamp's Landing restaurant conditionally approved. Patio seating must close by 10 p.m.; amplified music and live entertainment are banned around the patio.

grade.rationale: Page 3 conditions 3.5 and 3.7 support the patio-only 10 p.m. curfew and ban on amplified music/live entertainment around the patio.

results.text: 601 Stamp's Landing restaurant conditionally approved. The restaurant must close at 10 p.m. and install sprinklers before the development permit is issued.

blocking_issues: Page 3 applies the curfew to outdoor seating; later Building Review comments do not require installed sprinklers before the development permit.
grade.rationale: Page 3 applies the curfew to outdoor seating; later Building Review comments do not require installed sprinklers before the development permit.

results.text: 3631 Point Grey Rd conversion conditionally approved. Plans must lower the lower-floor ceiling by 1 ft and keep solar panels at least 2 ft from roof edges and ridge.

grade.rationale: Page 2 specifies the lower-floor ceiling reduction of one foot and a minimum two-foot solar-panel setback from perimeter and ridge. Both scope and minimum are preserved.

results.text: 3631 Point Grey Rd conversion conditionally approved. Every ceiling must be lowered by 2 ft and solar panels removed.

blocking_issues: Page 2 says one foot on the lower floor, not two feet on every ceiling, and calls for solar setbacks rather than removal.
grade.rationale: Page 2 says one foot on the lower floor, not two feet on every ceiling, and calls for solar setbacks rather than removal.

results.text: 3989 Fraser St rental project conditionally approved. Conditions include funding sidewalks, a lane crossing and duct banks, backed by a letter of credit or City-approved security.

grade.rationale: Page 5 names sidewalks, lane crossing and duct banks at no City cost; pages 5–6 permit a letter of credit OR other approved security. The reference supplies no invented amount.

results.text: 3989 Fraser St rental project conditionally approved. It must pay a $500,000 cash deposit and finish all street works before the development permit.

blocking_issues: No $500,000 amount or cash-only requirement appears. The Services Agreement precedes the permit; completed street construction does not.
grade.rationale: No $500,000 amount or cash-only requirement appears. The Services Agreement precedes the permit; completed street construction does not.

results.text: 222 Keefer St SRO renovation conditionally approved. It needs a separate permit to convert 6 protected rooms, plus agreements for structures extending over the street and lane.

grade.rationale: Page 2 requires arrangements for separate conversion/demolition permission for six designated rooms, plus specific street/lane encroachment agreements. The reference describes permission to convert, not compelled demolition.

results.text: 222 Keefer St SRO approved for construction. The City requires 6 rooms to be demolished and a $100,000 payment.

blocking_issues: Pages 1–2 do not establish construction authorization, compulsory physical demolition or a $100,000 payment.
grade.rationale: Pages 1–2 do not establish construction authorization, compulsory physical demolition or a $100,000 payment.

results.text: 1410 E 49th Ave daycare conditionally approved. It needs on-site outdoor play space; indoor space cannot substitute. Plans must show at least 2 passenger spaces and at least 3 bike spaces.

grade.rationale: Page 2 requires outdoor play space without indoor substitution and minimum counts of two passenger and three bicycle spaces. The reference preserves those minimums.

results.text: 1410 E 49th Ave daycare conditionally approved. An indoor playroom may replace outdoor space for all 20 licensed children.

blocking_issues: Page 2 explicitly prohibits indoor substitution; page 1's up-to-twenty capacity is not a final licence for twenty children.
grade.rationale: Page 2 explicitly prohibits indoor substitution; page 1's up-to-twenty capacity is not a final licence for twenty children.

results.text: 3333 Bridgeway daycare conditionally approved. Revised plans must show at least 15 passenger-loading spaces and at least 5 accessible parking spaces, including one van-accessible space.

grade.rationale: Page 2 requires at least fifteen passenger spaces and five accessible spaces including a van-accessible first space. Revised plans is the correct stage.

results.text: 3333 Bridgeway daycare must construct 41 car parking spaces before receiving its development permit.

blocking_issues: The source separates bikes, passenger loading and accessible parking. It does not require forty-one car spaces or completed construction before issuance.
grade.rationale: The source separates bikes, passenger loading and accessible parking. It does not require forty-one car spaces or completed construction before issuance.

results.text: 3550 Kingsway daycare expansion conditionally approved. Building review calls for code, structural and falling-hazard reports and flags upgrades across the entire building.

results.text: 3550 Kingsway daycare expansion conditionally approved. It must cover at least 20% of outdoor space and complete whole-building upgrades before the development permit.

blocking_issues: Outdoor cover is a recommendation, not a twenty-percent minimum. The building review does not require completed upgrades before the development permit.
grade.rationale: Outdoor cover is a recommendation, not a twenty-percent minimum. The building review does not require completed upgrades before the development permit.

results.text: 4666 Main St rental building conditionally approved. Conditions include a 2.5 m public pedestrian right-of-way and a sidewalk at least 3 m wide.

grade.rationale: Page 5 requires a 2.5 m public pedestrian right-of-way; page 3 specifies a minimum 3 m sidewalk. Both dimensions and the minimum survive.

results.text: 4666 Main St rental building conditionally approved. It needs a 2.5 m public right-of-way and a housing agreement that ends after 60 years.

blocking_issues: Pages 5–6 require the longer of sixty years and building life, so the draft's definite sixty-year expiry is false.
grade.rationale: Pages 5–6 require the longer of sixty years and building life, so the draft's definite sixty-year expiry is false.

results.text: 2421 E 41st Ave duplexes conditionally approved. Plans must protect 6 neighbouring trees, retain the west-side wall/fence and route utility trenches away from their roots.

grade.rationale: Pages 4–5 identify six off-site neighbouring trees, retention of the west-side wall/fence and utility coordination to avoid their critical root zones. These are concrete design constraints.

results.text: 2421 E 41st Ave duplexes conditionally approved. All foundations must use L-shaped footings and the developer must add 6 parking spaces.

blocking_issues: The foundation method depends on arborist recommendations and tree conflicts; it is not a universal L-footing mandate. Page 1's zero proposed parking does not require six new spaces.

results.text: Approval conditions: 840 Hemlock St rental building. All 13 units must remain rental housing for 60 years, after which the restriction ends.

blocking_issues: The draft improperly adds the thirteenth commercial unit and a fixed sixty-year end date, contrary to page 2.
grade.rationale: The draft improperly adds the thirteenth commercial unit and a fixed sixty-year end date, contrary to page 2.

results.text: Approval conditions: 960 Juniper St apartments. Pay a non-refundable $250,000 fee and finish the frontage works before the development permit is issued.

blocking_issues: The draft changes returnable alternative security into a fee and moves physical completion from occupancy to development-permit issuance.

results.text: 120 Alder St daycare conditionally approved. It must build 6 passenger spaces and 6 stroller spaces before the development permit.

blocking_issues: The draft adds mutually exclusive options and invents a construction deadline; pages 1–2 expressly rule both out.
grade.rationale: The draft adds mutually exclusive options and invents a construction deadline; pages 1–2 expressly rule both out.

blocking_issues: Page 1 requires only acknowledgement before the development permit; page 2's retrofit completion is tied to occupancy.

blocking_issues: Page 1 excludes the shop and uses the longer-of duration. The draft gets both scope and endpoint wrong.

blocking_issues: The rejection and $999,999 penalty appear only in the malicious quoted comment on page 2 and are explicitly not City conditions.
